name: io.github.Modelglass/modelglass
title: Modelglass
description: Sourced AI-model pricing and capability data — compare and route to the cheapest capable model.

tools.name: modelglass_list_models
tools.description: List AI models tracked by Modelglass across image, LLM, video, and audio modalities, with current pricing and technical profile. By default returns only current-generation models. Pass generation='all' to include previous generations, or generation='previous' to see superseded models only.

provider.description: Filter to a provider slug, e.g. 'replicate'. A canonical company id (e.g. 'google', 'openai', 'together') expands to that company's offerings across every vertical it spans (image/llm/video/audio) instead of just one raw slug.

arch.description: Filter to an architecture vocabulary id.

modality.description: Filter to a modality group: image, llm, video, or audio.

generation.description: Filter by model generation. 'current' (default) returns only active-generation models; 'previous' returns superseded generations; 'all' returns every generation.

tools.name: modelglass_get_model
tools.description: Get pricing history, capability profile, and benchmark scores for a specific AI model. Pricing-history depth depends on your plan: free sees prices effective in the last 2 days, starter the last 12 months, pro/internal the full history — every plan always sees at least the current price.

tools.name: modelglass_compare_models
tools.description: Compare two or more models side-by-side across pricing and capability dimensions. Useful for routing decisions. Every plan gets each model's current prices, capability ratings (with per-rating notes), static profile fields (creator, architecture, release date, generation), a comparison_url deep link to the rendered comparison on the web, and data-derived routing_hints. Pro and internal keys additionally get: unit-matched price deltas and spread across every compared model (price_comparison), a per-dimension capability rating diff that marks 'unverifiable' rather than silently comparing a real rating against nothing (capability_diff), and price-stability history — age, cut/raise, magnitude — per model (price_stability), where each row names its offering slug and lists any scheduled price changes that haven't taken effect yet (upcoming_changes: UTC effective instant, new price, % change vs current, days until, source). Free/App/Starter responses omit these three fields entirely rather than returning them empty; upgrade at https://modelglass.com.au/signup for the extended comparison.

model_ids.description: Two to ten model ids to compare.

tools.name: modelglass_get_pricing_feed
tools.description: Get the current active pricing for all models in a normalised, machine-readable format optimised for routing logic. Returns one row per active tier price. Rows with headline: false are real but non-list rates (Batch, Flex, off-peak, and prompt-cache reads/writes, whose units are per_1m_tokens_cache_read / per_1m_tokens_cache_write); filter on headline: true before taking the cheapest row per unit. Token units (per_1m_tokens_*) are shared across modalities, so also filter on modality; token_modality says which medium a token rate applies to. Treat an unknown unit as not comparable.

provider.description: Optional provider slug to filter the feed. A canonical company id (e.g. 'google', 'openai', 'together') expands to that company's offerings across every vertical it spans.

tools.name: modelglass_route_task
tools.description: Recommend the best current-generation LLM for a coding task category, ranked by the same benchmark/capability data the other tools expose (SWE-bench Pro/Verified, Vibe Code Bench (Vals AI, OpenHands harness), Terminal-Bench 4.0 (Vals AI, Mini-SWE-agent harness), BigCodeBench, or a qualitative capability-rating fallback for categories no benchmark covers well). Recommendation only — this never calls a provider or touches an API key; pass the returned model_id to your own inference call. Optionally restrict to specific providers (e.g. the ones you have keys for). Coverage is honestly reported: some category/provider combinations currently have zero ranked models because the underlying benchmark hasn't been sourced for that model yet (see 'unscored') or the benchmark itself is barely tracked industry-wide (library-aware-feature-work/BigCodeBench today) — this tool never fabricates a ranking to fill the gap. new-code-generation and terminal-cli are ranked in tie bands: models whose scores are within each other's measurement error (95%) and within 3 points of the band's top model are treated as tied and listed cheapest first, and each carries 'band' (1 = top). A model with no published standard error ties only an exact score. A ranked model whose provider has announced a shutdown carries 'shutdown_date'; after that date it isn't ranked. Preview models are left out unless include_preview is true. If the question names one of the specific tracked benchmarks — SWE-bench Pro, SWE-bench Verified, Vibe Code Bench, Terminal-Bench 4.0, BigCodeBench — do NOT use this tool to answer it: this tool's score is a per-category choice among several candidate benchmarks, not that benchmark's raw score (e.g. bug-fix and refactor prefer SWE-bench Pro over SWE-bench Verified whenever a model has both, so a model's rank here can sit well below where its named-benchmark score alone would place it). Use modelglass_list_models or modelglass_get_model instead — both return each tracked benchmark's raw score directly, with no category substitution.

category.description: The kind of coding task to route: bug-fix, new-code-generation, terminal-cli, library-aware-feature-work, refactor, test-gen, doc-gen, chat-explain, or autocomplete.

providers.description: Optional list of provider slugs to restrict the recommendation to (e.g. the caller's own configured providers). A canonical company id (e.g. 'google', 'openai', 'together') expands to that company's offerings across every vertical it spans. Omit to rank across every provider.

include_preview.description: Include models whose status is preview (default false). Preview models can change or be withdrawn without notice, so they aren't recommended unless you ask for them.

tools.name: modelglass_get_account
tools.description: Get the calling API key's own account status: plan tier, key status, and key metadata. Scoped to the calling credential only — not the full account key list GET /v1/keys returns on the REST API. Useful for tier-gated automation (e.g. a tool that requires Starter or Pro before proceeding) that needs to check its own entitlement rather than assuming it from the key's string prefix, which is a display convention, not a contract.

tools.name: modelglass_get_competitors
tools.description: Get the closest competitors for a model, enriched with live pricing data: current price and price delta ratio relative to the source model (only computed when both share the same billing unit). A retired or withdrawn competitor has current_price null and a last_price (the last price it charged, with its effective_to) — never treat last_price as live; price_delta_ratio is null whenever either side has no current price. Competitor candidates come from the registry's curated closest_competitors field, not a computed similarity search. Available to every plan — no tier gate, matching the REST /v1/models/:modelId/competitors route.
